issue_context.title: Konnected.io keeps getting discovered although already configured
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Konnected.io boards keeps getting discovered although they have already been configured. 

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.10.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

konnected.io

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/konnected/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

_No response_

### Additional information

comments:
Hey there @heythisisnate, @kit-klein, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`konnected`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L275) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Same issue here. I saw one dialog that let me "Ignore" it but none of the others will let me.

![Screen Shot 2021-10-13 at 10 42 07 AM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5626027/137167539-d2dfc87e-8c4f-44eb-94c4-25bb0aabf564.png)

versions: 

core-2021.10.4

supervisor-2021.10.0

Same issue here (I have 2 boards only and both already configured):

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18703684/140034880-592dba4e-5dc5-42d7-8954-9c19472ddaa6.png)

Same issue here. I also have 2 Pro boards already configured. I emailed support but the support response was "We've indicated that this question or issue has been resolved". I also tried adding deviceid, host, andport to configuration.yaml and setting discovery = false as outlined at https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/konnected/. Upon reboot, still discovers already configured devices.

Interestingly my single board installation stopped exhibiting this problem after a week or two.  It’s been normal for several weeks now.  I didn’t do anything specific to solve that I can recall.  I do keep fairly current on updates to HA.  FYI

I'm looking into this issue on behalf of Konnected but I have not successfully reproduced it.

Can any of you provide some detail as to how this may be triggered? Were your devices updated or configurations changed before this occurred? Are you still experiencing this with the latest Home Assistant?

Not much to go on, but a simple reboot causes these to be rediscovered. I don't know if this helps, but I do have these hooked up via Ethernet (Not WIFI). Unifi network (Gateway Pro 4, 48 Port Switch and 24 Port POE Switch). I run the konnected boards off of a dedicated power supply. The konnected boards are on the latest firmware v0.1.5-047de6 and app v1.2.5. At this time I have nothing in my configuration.yaml in regards to konnected. As stated earlier, when I run the config after discovery, the fields are prepopulated with my dedicated IP for each (separate IPs) and ports. When clicking submit, I get a message that says "Already Configured". Very nice of you to look into this on their behalf but with all of the changes in HA over the last year it seems to me a ton of code changes/additions are going so quickly, this may get overlooked. I will say, i love these boards. Rock solid so far and I am able to trust them.
Similar unifi kit whereby Konnected Pro board (on latest firmware) is powered by both POE and separate (battery backed up) psu. Occurs on every boot.
Thank you for the input. I have been able to reproduce this now and am looking into the fix.
Just to add, mine are on Wifi not ethernet but I also have a UniFi set up, if thats of interest. Let me know if I can get any logs etc to help.
Thank you for the offer, I believe I have found the error and rectified it. Currently testing successfully, hopefully have a PR ready soon.
h2zero, Thank you for your time on this. Although rarely said, it is appreciated by many. Looking forward to the update.
You're most welcome 😄 , I hope it's merged and included in the next release.

> h2zero, Thank you for your time on this. Although rarely said, it is appreciated by many. Looking forward to the update.

Yes, thank you
